record.source_text: (1) Tax-free reserves (in the case of profit determination pursuant to Section 4(3), tax-free amounts) may be formed up to 10% of the profit — before deduction of trade tax and of an investment allowance claimed as a profit-reducing item and — after deduction of all other business expenses.
